Harm-reduction education, not a protocol. Prescription-only, research chemicals, or banned substances (incl. Malaysia); several are acutely dangerous.
Reference doses are illustrative, not instructions. Work with a physician; rely on bloodwork. · Style: Engineering Diagnostic Instrument · Aether ground.
